criteria.reason: The preflight is pinned to commit 3194156 and renders all nine partitions without proximity, pair expansion, or wildcards.
Four assigned labels were exact preferred Ei Thesaurus concepts with numeric IDs, hierarchy, scope-note, and no-explosion evidence read twice.
Two historical native B1 RIS passes had identical assignments, and fresh terminal one-page CV checks reproduced the expected P and M_H known sets.
The candidate constructions were OR supplements to complete P and M_H free-text blocks.
Both lossless candidate-only routes returned explicit source zero twice, so the tested augmented B1 added no Compendex accession.
The P and context-qualified M_H controlled constructions each matched only 3 of 11 selected records. Controlled terms cannot replace free text.
The source exposed navigational relations without an explode control. No broader or narrower concept was silently included.

rationale: Nanosatellites and Small satellites repeat normative population labels in a distinct CV field but added no B1 record.
Systems engineering is too generic for M_H alone and was tested only with Modeling languages.
The context-qualified M_H construction had assignment evidence but added no B1 record.
SysML was an exact descriptor but had no selected-record assignment, so it failed the fixed assignment criterion.
The exact direct labels Model-based systems engineering and CubeSat were absent from the preferred-term surface.
An OR supplement with zero observed marginal recall adds complexity without evidence of value.
prospective_translation: Retain the complete post-proximity literal ALL schedule with no Ei Thesaurus supplement. Keep free text mandatory.

adapter_repair.finding: Engineering Village omits the numeric result interval and mirrors the legacy Next ID. Adapter v15 accepts the absent interval as optional corroboration, scopes the top paginator, and waits through the brief empty-row shell after one click. Bounded one-page, two-page, strict, and paired checks passed.

limitations: The value test covers P and M_H candidates in B1. It does not prove that every possible descriptor for every other concept lacks value.
The eleven records are vocabulary known items, not final screening decisions.
Pilot 003 assignments are reused only because B1 was unchanged by the protocol commit.
The portal exposes no Ei Thesaurus release identifier or documented concept-ID stability guarantee.
The adapter repair validates capture behavior. No current full schedule or final search was run.
No current changed-partition Pilot 003 set, final search, or merge-eligible pilot artifact was created.
